latest_accepted_family.name: My Neck Will Be Your Sheath

notes: Chapters216-219 are accepted as My Neck Will Be Your Sheath (1)-(4).
Target216 is the first explicit source identification of the Corpse Queen as Camus Morgue.
Camus left Adolf's Light Faction for Snake's Dark Faction and black magic because she believed Vikir dead and wanted to resurrect him.
Art of Complete Resurrection spends the caster's life and requires physical remains; Camus's failed attempt left catastrophic half-alive/half-brain-dead damage before Seere's contract.
Camus/Seere share the body in twelve-hour control shifts rather than ordinary total possession.
Vikir's feelings for Camus remain deliberately uncategorized; source uses a younger-sister-like protective comparison rather than declaring romance.
Camus overrides Seere past her allotted control window and gives Vikir an opening.
Vikir reaches genuine Sword Master without Dolores's external Saintess buff.
Completed Seventh Fang can cut the Camus-Seere conceptual contract.
Removing the Lens / Heart Sword are conceptual Sword Master explanations, not numbered Baskerville techniques.
Vikir severs the contract, ejects Seere, and destroys the Eighth Corpse with seven Fangs while leaving Camus physically intact.
Vikir deliberately lets Rosie Morgue/Geronto evacuate Camus for black-mage-compatible treatment.
The family closes with Vikir consciously worrying whether Camus will be all right.
